title: A re-dispatched worker is bound to its previous run's finished session, so kbtail shows the old transcript and nothing of the live run
goal: a worker dispatched again on the same item is bound to its live session, not to the previous run's worker_session in the claims ledger, so kbtail and the sessions panel show the live run's transcript

run:
import json, os, random, shutil, string, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time, uuid
if os.name == "nt":
    print("check skipped: a fake claude process needs a POSIX host"); sys.exit(0)
R = os.getcwd(); T = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp()); C = os.path.join(T, "cfg"); S = os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite")
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_")}
env.update(CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=C, COLUMNS="200", KB_COORD_STORE=S)
def sh(*a, cwd=T):
    return subprocess.run(a, cwd=cwd, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
K = os.path.join(T, "clone"); os.makedirs(K)
sh("git", "init", "-q", ".", cwd=K)
sh("git", "-c", "user.email=a@example.com", "-c", "user.name=n", "commit", "-q", "--allow-empty", "-m", "i", cwd=K)
shutil.copy(os.path.join(R, "backlog.json"), K); os.makedirs(os.path.join(K, "kb", "_self", "backlog"))
os.makedirs(os.path.join(T, "bin")); FAKE = os.path.join(T, "bin", "claude"); os.symlink("/bin/sleep", FAKE)
procs = []
def transcript(base, sid, text):
    pdir = os.path.join(C, "projects", "".join(c if c.isalnum() else "-" for c in base)); os.makedirs(pdir, exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(pdir, sid + ".jsonl"), "w") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps({"type": "user", "cwd": base, "sessionId": sid, "timestamp": "2026-10-26T10:00:00Z",
                            "message": {"role": "user", "content": text}}) + "\n")
def session(base, text):
    sid = str(uuid.uuid4())
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(base, "_cache", "coord_hook"), exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(base, "_cache", "coord_hook", sid + ".json"), "w") as f:
        json.dump({"items": [], "lease_until": time.time() + 600, "token": "t"}, f)
    sh(sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "coord.py"), "--store", S, "claim", "session/" + sid, "--ttl", "600", "--holder", "h")
    transcript(base, sid, text)
    procs.append(subprocess.Popen([FAKE, "120"], cwd=base))
    return sid, procs[-1].pid
def kbtail(*a):
    return sh(sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "kbtail.py"), "--root", K, *a)
WT = os.path.join(K, ".claude", "worktrees", "agent-ST-aaaaaaaa")
sh("git", "worktree", "add", "-q", "-b", "work/ST-aaaaaaaa", WT, cwd=K)
try:
    live, pid = session(WT, "planted-live-run")
    old = str(uuid.uuid4())
    transcript(WT, old, "planted-old-run")
    gd = sh("git", "-C", WT, "rev-parse", "--absolute-git-dir").stdout.strip()
    with open(os.path.join(gd, "kb-backlog-claims.json"), "w") as f:
        json.dump({"ST-aaaaaaaa": {"worker_pid": pid, "worker_session": old}}, f)
    time.sleep(0.5)
    r = kbtail("--once")
    problems = []
    if "planted-live-run" not in r.stdout:
        problems.append("the re-dispatched worker's live session is not shown: %s" % r.stdout[-200:])
    if "planted-old-run" in r.stdout:
        problems.append("the previous run's finished transcript is shown for the live worker")
finally:
    for p in procs: p.kill()
print("\n".join(problems) or "ok")
sys.exit(1 if problems else 0)

gates.question: Where is the previous run's worker_session kept out of a live worker's binding?
options: in the readers: a pid that still runs never takes the record's worker_session
in dispatch: clear worker_session when worker_pid is recorded
gates.recommendation: in the readers: a pid that still runs never takes the record's worker_session
gates.reason: dispatch --resume still finds the last session of a worker that died
gates.answer: in the readers: a pid that still runs never takes the record's worker_session

notes: Fresh review of SP-7ba3r4ec, gap 2 (S2, raised to S1 by the operator): bind_sessions prefers the ledger's dispatch record; bl_dispatch records worker_session only when a worker exits, so the record holds the last run's session while the new pid runs. Fix in the binding (a leased hook session of the checkout that is newer than the record's) or in dispatch (clear worker_session when it records worker_pid).
